!> write site-symmetry matrices for standalone Wannier90
   LOGICAL, PRIVATE, SAVE :: WRITE_DMN=.FALSE.
   PRIVATE :: MLWF_WANNIER90_DMN, MLWF_DMN_ORBITALS

CALL PROCESS_INCAR(LOPEN, IU0, IU5, 'LWRITE_DMN', WRITE_DMN, IERR, WRITEXMLINCAR)
   IF (WRITE_DMN.AND.(.NOT.LWANNIER90.OR.LWANNIER90_RUN.OR..NOT.WRITE_MMN_AMN)) &
      CALL vtutor%error('LWRITE_DMN requires LWANNIER90 and LWRITE_MMN_AMN, with LWANNIER90_RUN disabled.')

IF (WRITE_DMN) THEN
      IF (.NOT.PRESENT(SYMM).OR.MY_LWANNIER90_RUN) &
         CALL vtutor%error('LWRITE_DMN requires the standalone Wannier90 export from the VASP main driver.')
      IF (P_MLWF%PROJ_MODE/=PROJ_WANNIER90) &
         CALL vtutor%error('LWRITE_DMN requires explicit projections in the Wannier90 input.')
      CALL MLWF_WANNIER90_DMN(P_MLWF,W,P,CQIJ,T_INFO,LATT_CUR,SYMM,IO)
   ENDIF

IF (WRITE_DMN.AND.ESTIMATED_NUM_WANN/=MLWF%NUM_WANN) &
      CALL vtutor%error('LWRITE_DMN requires exactly NUM_WANN explicit Wannier90 projections.')

! The cell label of a projection fixes its symmetry phase.
      IF (WRITE_DMN) MLWF%LPRJ_functions(IS)%R=proj_site(:,IS)

ISP_IRZ=ISP
          IF (WRITE_DMN.AND.MLWF%ISPIN==2) THEN
             IF (KPOINTS_FULL%SPINFLIP(NKI)==1) ISP_IRZ=3-ISP
          ENDIF
logical,optional,intent(in) :: full_bloch !< Include reciprocal folding and the Bloch translation phase

gshift=0
        kphase=0._q
        if (present(full_bloch)) then
            if (full_bloch) then
                dk=matmul(wa_original%wdes1%vkpt,rot)-wa_rotated%wdes1%vkpt
                gshift=nint(dk)
                if (maxval(abs(dk-gshift))>1e-5_q) &
                    call vtutor%error("wave_rotator: destination k must equal rotated k modulo a reciprocal vector")
                kphase=-tpi*dot_product(wa_rotated%wdes1%vkpt,self%gtrans(:,abs_irot))
            endif
        endif
